_comment: WF-V6 per-subject turnaround contract (scripts/v6/README.md), written by gold.mjs new 2026-09-28. Vehicle author frame: nose +z, near flank +x, y up, ground y = 0, x and z centred. No regions.json: families.table = flat colours of the concept; families.body names the body family.
_note: 2026-09-29: turnaround regenerated (Gemini sheet + repairs, scripts/v7/turnaround.mjs; the previous GPT set is ../turnaround-1-gpt); per-view shift / scale / drift / holes measured on the previous images are not carried over — re-measure them on these images at the setup audit. Dropped (measured on the previous images): none present.

top._scale: 2026-10-02 orchestrator correction at the r1 boundary: the audit's 0.853 was the inverse (scale k = drawn k x too long); doctor sweep k 0.853/1.0/1.17/1.3 -> residual-W top +22.5/+11.1/clear/-6.5 %, hull top 11.2/9.3/7.6/6.3 %; 1.17 clears the width residual

anchor._why: 2026-09-29: the W anchor = the body family (fuselage) width, 3.8 m = a CH-47-class fuselage (the real-size sentence of the concept prompt gives the 18.3 m ROTOR diameter, not a fuselage width). Re-derived on the installed set the stated sizes disagree: rotor span / fuselage W (front view ~2.1) would give ~8.7 m, the side view rotor tip-to-tip / fuselage L (~1.4 of 30 m) ~6.2 m — the generated rotors are drawn short; kept 3.8 m pending the setup audit / owner.

families._enclosedFg: off until the setup audit decides (see-through parts stay background)
families._table: 2026-09-29 (setup, from the concept family masks): body = the olive fuselage, pylons and flank fairings (proposal body #4f553a flanks + f2 #646a4b lit roof / nose + f5 #3c4031 edges); rotor = the gunmetal rotor blades and hubs (f3 #545556); glass = cockpit and cabin windows (f4 #40464f); dark = tyres, gear legs and the engine intake grilles (#2c2e2a). The body family is the FUSELAGE, so the W anchor is the fuselage width, not the 18.3 m rotor diameter of the concept prompt (see anchor._why).
families._viewTable: 2026-09-29: per-view colours of the families (scripts/v7/turnaround.mjs families --apply; out/turnaround/transport_heli/families.proposal.json): each view's foreground colour clusters (>= 1 %) matched to the table's families with ONE per-view colour offset (side -2.8 -6.3 -6.3 · front +3.9 +0.2 +1.2 · rear +6.3 +3.5 +1.3 · top +5.4 +2 -0.2); ambiguous: side #484c4e 7.5 % rotor (vs glass); side #46525d 1.1 % rotor (vs glass); side #5e5e5d 1.1 % rotor (vs body); front #4c4e44 8.1 % body (vs glass); front #434f59 7.8 % glass (vs rotor); front #5e6143 1.9 % body (vs rotor); top #34352f 2.7 % dark (vs body). Measured on these images: turnaround.mjs re-derives it for any other image set and install writes it for the installed one.

front rotor aft blade drawn to x 540 (4.8 m); with the concept's yaw (132 / 252 deg aft) the side projection is 0.67 R = 3.1 m -> x ~458
rear rotor aft blade drawn to x 912 (4.0 m from the hub at 720); concept yaw gives 0.67 R = 3.1 m -> x ~869

front.why: a blade drawn descending from the hub to 600,440 (up 4.35 m): a projection error (blades are level in every other view and in the concept); the concept's forward blade (12 deg) is a 0.2 R stub here
near-side (image right) blades drawn full length to x 707 (R 4.0 m); concept yaw 132 deg -> 0.74 R = 3.4 m -> tip at x ~678
far-side tip zone: drawn to x 324 (R 4.0 m); concept R 4.6 m at 252 deg -> 0.95 R = 4.4 m -> tip at x ~305

rear.why: near-side (+x = image left) blades drawn full length to x 291 (R 4.6 m); concept yaw 132 deg -> 0.74 R = 3.4 m -> tip at x ~349

concept.why: front-left wheel drawn under the nose centre: by the solved camera (hub 300,455 at 5.2-5.5 m up) its x is 0.2-0.7 m; the front view's legs stand at +-1.25 m (455 / 575 px) -> the model's wheel sits ~50 px further right-down here
rear-left wheel: same camera reading gives x 0-0.4 m (a drawing licence: it looks under the fairing edge); the rear view's legs stand at +-1.3 m (447 / 580 px)
front rotor rear-near blade drawn at 147 deg (plan, from +z toward +x); the model's equal-spaced set 12 / 132 / 252 deg puts it at 132 deg (the top view draws it at 150 deg): the tip moves ~1.2 m
rear rotor rear-near blade drawn at 148 deg; modelled at 132 deg (see D10)
